# Migrate component hooks to SafeHooks

This branch already adds `net.wiringbits.core.SafeHooks` and the reviewer rule / `RULE-FE-006` requiring it (see
`.orca/reviewers/frontend.md` and `docs/guide/frontend.md`). Now migrate the existing call sites so the codebase
follows the new rule. **Pure, behaviour-preserving refactor** — no behaviour, API, or styling changes.

## What to change

Replace direct `Hooks.useEffect` / `Hooks.useMemo` / `Hooks.useCallback` calls **that take a dependency list** in
component code (`web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/components/**`) with the `SafeHooks` equivalents, whose dependencies
are `String` keys:

- `Hooks.useEffect(fn, js.Array(k))` → `SafeHooks.useEffect(k)(fn)`
- `Hooks.useMemo(() => v, js.Array(k))` → `SafeHooks.useMemo(k)(() => v)`
- `Hooks.useCallback(fn, js.Array(k))` → `SafeHooks.useCallback(k)(fn)`
- the empty-deps idiom `Hooks.use*(…, "")` (or `List()`/`Nil`) → the no-arg form `SafeHooks.use*()(…)` (compute once)

Dependency keys must be `String`. Most sites already pass `js.Array` of a `String` key — pass those straight through.
For any dependency that is not already a `String`:
- a primitive (`Int`/`Boolean`/etc.) → `.toString`;
- several values → one key, e.g. `s"$a:$b"` or `ids.map(_.toString).mkString(",")`;
- an object (collection / `Option` / case class / `UUID` / `Long` / `Char`) → derive a `String` key the same way — do
  NOT pass the object. (These are exactly the unstable deps `SafeHooks` exists to prevent; there likely aren't any in
  components, but if one appears, key it by its id/content, preserving the existing trigger behaviour.)

~34 call sites across the files under `components/pages` and `components/widgets` listed by
`grep -rn "Hooks\.\(useEffect\|useMemo\|useCallback\)(" web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/components`.

## Leave untouched

- `Hooks.useEffect(fn)` with **no** dependency argument (runs every render — intentional; `SafeHooks` does not cover it).
- `Hooks.useState`, `Hooks.useRef`, `Hooks.useContext` (no dependency list).
- Everything in `net.wiringbits.core` — `ReactiveHooks`, `I18nHooks`, `SafeHooks` itself — these deliberately use raw
  `Hooks` and key on a stable object reference.
- `AsyncComponent(... watchedObjects = List(...))` — that is a separate component prop, not a `Hooks.use*` call; do not
  touch it.

## Constraints

- Behaviour-preserving: every migrated hook fires under exactly the same conditions as before (same keys / same
  compute-once semantics). Remove now-unused `scala.scalajs.js` imports only where they became unused.
- Follow `.orca/reviewers/frontend.md` and `RULE-FE-006`.
- `web/Test/compile` passes and all web tests stay green. Do not modify `HookDepsProbeSpec` or `SafeHooksSpec`.

## Acceptance

- No component under `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/components` calls `Hooks.useEffect`/`useMemo`/`useCallback` with
  a dependency list any more — they go through `SafeHooks` with `String` keys; the no-dependency `useEffect(fn)` and the
  `core` utilities remain on raw `Hooks`.
- The app builds and web tests pass; the UI behaves exactly as before.

resultJson.description:
This epic moves every component in `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/components/**` that calls `Hooks.useEffect` / `Hooks.useMemo` / `Hooks.useCallback` with a dependency list over to `net.wiringbits.core.SafeHooks`, which only accepts `String` dependency keys. `SafeHooks`, RULE-FE-006 (docs/guide/frontend.md) and the reviewer rule (.orca/reviewers/frontend.md) are already on this branch. This change only updates the call sites so the codebase follows the rule. React compares deps with `Object.is`, so in Scala.js only String/Int/Double/Boolean compare by value. Forcing `String` keys makes the "fresh object every render" bug impossible to write.

This is a pure refactor that must not change behaviour. Each migrated hook must fire under exactly the same conditions as before: the same keys, and compute-once stays compute-once. Most sites already pass a `String` key or use an empty-deps idiom (`""`, `Seq.empty`, `js.Array()`, `js.Array[Any]()`, or the constant `js.Array("")`), so they migrate mechanically. One site passes an `Int` (`BulkMerchantSetupPage`, `List(page)`), which becomes `page.toString`. Two files currently pass Scala objects (state-held `List`s / `Option` of case classes) as deps: `BankStatementReviewContent` (four `useMemo`s) and `ReceiptsPage` (one `useMemo`). Those need content-derived `String` keys that change exactly when the referenced data changes. The memos are pure, so content keys give the same results.

Out of scope: `Hooks.useEffect(fn)` with no deps argument, `useState`/`useRef`/`useContext`, everything in `net.wiringbits.core`, and `AsyncComponent(watchedObjects = ...)`. Done means the grep `Hooks\.(useEffect|useMemo|useCallback)\(` under `components/` returns no call that has a deps argument, `CI=true sbt web/Test/compile` passes, and the existing web specs stay green. `HookDepsProbeSpec` and `SafeHooksSpec` are not modified.

tasks.title: Migrate compute-once hook sites in small pages/widgets to SafeHooks
tasks.description:
Convert the empty-deps / constant-key sites to the no-arg form `SafeHooks.use*()(...)`:
- AppSplash.scala:23 (`""`)
- UserEditPage.scala:54 and :56 (`Seq.empty`, both)
- VerifyEmailWithTokenPage.scala:86 (`""`)
- MerchantReviewPage.scala:48 (`js.Array[Any]()`)
- BankStatementAutoReconcilePage.scala:81 useMemo (`""`) and :91 useEffect (`js.Array("")`)
- BankRowLinkPicker.scala:39 (`js.Array("")`)
- BankRowCreateExpenseForm.scala:202 (`""`)
- widgets/ReCaptcha.scala:22 useMemo (`""`)

A constant `js.Array("")` key never changes, so it is equivalent to compute-once. Use the no-arg form. Add `import net.wiringbits.core.SafeHooks` and keep `Hooks` imported wherever `Hooks.useState`/`useRef` is still used. Remove `scala.scalajs.js` imports only if they became unused (many of these files still use `js.` elsewhere). Verify: `CI=true sbt web/Test/compile`, then `sbt "web/testOnly *UserEditPageSpec *BankRowCreateExpenseFormSpec"`.

tasks.title: Migrate String/Int-keyed hook sites in remaining pages to SafeHooks
tasks.description:
Convert the sites that already have a `String` key (pass it straight through) and the one `Int` key:
- ImportRulesPage.scala:136 (`merchantsKey`) and :143 (`categoriesKey`)
- BulkExpenseCreationPage.scala:109 (`List(descParam.getOrElse(""))`): key is `descParam.getOrElse("")`
- BankStatementsPage.scala:148 (`""`, becomes no-arg), :151 (`draftsProcessingKey`), :201 (`stmtsKey`), :212 (`pendingKey`)
- BankStatementSuggestionsPolling.scala:39 (`suggestionsPollKey`)
- BulkMerchantSetupPage.scala:129 (`List(page)`, where page is an Int): key is `page.toString`
- MerchantsPage.scala:118 (`List(categoriesKey)`)
- BankRowCreateExpenseForm.scala:186 (`aiSuggestionKey`)

Do not change how any key is computed. Effects that return a cleanup function keep returning it (`SafeHooks.useEffect` takes `() => Any`). Fix imports as in the other tasks. Verify: `CI=true sbt web/Test/compile`, then `sbt "web/testOnly *BulkMerchantSetupPageSpec *ImportRuleListSpec *BankStatementListSpec *BankRowCreateExpenseFormSpec"`.

tasks.title: Migrate ReceiptsPage hooks to SafeHooks, including content key for effectiveRuleList
tasks.description:
ReceiptsPage.scala has eight sites:
- :162 useMemo with object deps `List(ruleList, props.merchants.data)`. Replace with a content key, e.g. `SafeHooks.useMemo(s"${ruleList}|${props.merchants.data.map(m => s"${m.id}:${m.name}").mkString(",")}")(...)`. The computation only reads `m.id`/`m.name` and every field of `Rule(id, action, pattern)`, so `ruleList.toString` is a complete key.
- :175 `receiptsKey`, :185 `pendingKey`, :251 `selectedIdKey`, :711 `batchActiveKey`: pass straight through.
- :209 `js.Array()`: no-arg form.
- :241 two String deps `(visibleForFilter.map(_.id.toString).mkString(","), receiptFilter)`. `receiptFilter` is a String. Pass both as varargs: `SafeHooks.useEffect(ids, receiptFilter)`.

The file still uses `js.` for typed arrays and listeners, so keep that import. Verify: `CI=true sbt web/Test/compile`, then `sbt "web/testOnly *ReceiptsLogicSpec"`.

tasks.title: Migrate BankStatementReviewContent memos/callbacks to SafeHooks with content keys
tasks.description:
BankStatementReviewContent.scala has six sites. Four of them are useMemos (lines 82-98) whose deps are Scala objects (state-held Lists/Option). Replace them with String content keys that change whenever the referenced data changes:
- Define per-input keys from state values: `rulesKey = ruleList.toString`, `merchantsKey = merchantList.toString`, `categoriesKey = categoryList.toString`, `aiKey = aiSuggestions.toString`, `rowsKey = statementRows.toString`, `expensesKey = expenseList.toString`. All of these are plain case classes or Lists of them with UUID/LocalDate/BigDecimal/Instant/Option fields, so `toString` covers every field.
- For the derived memos, compose the upstream input keys rather than stringifying derived values. effectiveRuleList: `s"$rulesKey|$merchantsKey"`. rowInfoById: rows + effectiveRule key + merchants + ai + categories. unlinkedExpensesByDate: `expensesKey`. expenseMatchById: rows + rowInfo key + expenses key. A derived memo changes exactly when its inputs change.
- :115 useCallback with `""`: `SafeHooks.useCallback()(...)`.
- :120 useCallback with `List(stmtId.toString)`: `SafeHooks.useCallback(stmtId.toString)(...)`.

Keep the explicit result type annotations so the useCallback implicit `T => js.Function` resolves. Keep the existing comments. Verify: `CI=true sbt web/Test/compile`, then `sbt "web/testOnly *BankStatementReviewRowSpec *BankStatementBulkRunsSpec *BankStatementReviewLogicSpec"`, then run `grep -rn "Hooks\.\(useEffect\|useMemo\|useCallback\)(" web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/components` and confirm no remaining call has a deps argument.

resultJson.brief:
MODULES
- web/ (Scala.js + Slinky React + MUI 5). Components: web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/components/{pages,widgets}, plus components/AppSplash.scala. Hook utilities: web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/core (do NOT touch: SafeHooks, ReactiveHooks, I18nHooks).
- Shared models in lib/api/shared (read-only here).

SAFEHOOKS API (web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/core/SafeHooks.scala)
  object SafeHooks {
    def useEffect(deps: String*)(effect: () => Any): Unit
    def useMemo[T](deps: String*)(value: () => T): T
    def useCallback[T](deps: String*)(callback: T)(implicit ev: T => js.Function): T
  }
No keys means compute-once (same as empty deps). Several keys go in as varargs (`SafeHooks.useEffect(a, b)(...)`). Import: `import net.wiringbits.core.SafeHooks`. Rewrite pattern:
  Hooks.useEffect(() => {...}, js.Array(k))  ->  SafeHooks.useEffect(k) { () => ... }   (or SafeHooks.useEffect(k)(() => {...}))
  Hooks.useMemo(() => v, "")                 ->  SafeHooks.useMemo()(() => v)
Effects that return a cleanup `() => ...` keep returning it. Keep explicit type annotations on useCallback vals (e.g. `val onRowAction: (UUID, RowAction) => Unit = SafeHooks.useCallback(...)(...)`) so the `T => js.Function` implicit resolves.

EMPTY-DEPS IDIOMS FOUND (all mean "once" and become the no-arg form): `""` (Slinky treats a String as Iterable[Char], so it is empty), `Seq.empty`, `js.Array()`, `js.Array[Any]()`. A constant `js.Array("")` key also never changes, so it is once too. HookDepsProbeSpec proves these are equivalent.

OBJECT DEPS (the real bugs SafeHooks prevents). Only two files:
- BankStatementReviewContent.scala:82-98: four useMemos keyed on state `List`s/`Option` (ruleList, merchantList, categoryList, aiSuggestions: Option[AiSuggestions], statementRows: List[GetBankStatement.StatementRowData], expenseList) and on derived memo values. These are state references, so they currently re-fire only when a setter runs. A content key re-fires when content changes, which gives the same results because the memos are pure. Use `.toString` of the source values: all are plain case classes (ImportRuleMatcher.Rule(id, action, pattern), StatementRowData, AiSuggestions(status, model, rows)), and their toString includes every field. For derived memos, compose the upstream input keys instead of stringifying derived Maps.
- ReceiptsPage.scala:162-165: useMemo on `List(ruleList, props.merchants.data)`. effectiveRules reads only m.id and m.name from merchants.
Everywhere else, deps are already Strings: ImportRulesPage merchantsKey/categoriesKey, BankStatementsPage draftsProcessingKey/stmtsKey/pendingKey, ReceiptsPage receiptsKey/pendingKey/selectedIdKey/batchActiveKey, BankStatementSuggestionsPolling suggestionsPollKey, MerchantsPage categoriesKey, BankRowCreateExpenseForm aiSuggestionKey, BulkExpenseCreationPage descParam.getOrElse(""), BankStatementReviewContent stmtId.toString. ReceiptsPage `receiptFilter` is a String (FilterNeedsConfirm = "needs_confirm"). BulkMerchantSetupPage:131 `List(page)`: page is an Int, so use page.toString.

IMPORTS
Keep `slinky.core.facade.Hooks` wherever useState/useRef remain (almost every file). Remove `scala.scalajs.js` only if nothing else in the file uses `js.`. Many files use it for typed arrays, js.Function1, or JSConverters. ReCaptcha.scala has no js import.

CONVENTIONS
- Behaviour-preserving only: do not change key computations, effect bodies, comments or styling. Match surrounding formatting; scalafmt runs later.
- RULE-FE-006 in docs/guide/frontend.md (lines ~78-119) and .orca/reviewers/frontend.md "Hook dependency lists go through SafeHooks".
- Do not modify web/src/test/.../HookDepsProbeSpec.scala or core/SafeHooksSpec.scala.
- Verification is targeted only: `CI=true sbt web/Test/compile` and `sbt "web/testOnly *XSpec"`. Do not run the full `sbt test`.
- Web tests need Node 24 on PATH (the default shell node is v16, and yarn install fails on it).
- Existing related specs in web/src/test/scala/net/wiringbits/components/pages: UserEditPageSpec, BulkMerchantSetupPageSpec, BankRowCreateExpenseFormSpec, ImportRuleListSpec, BankStatementListSpec, ReceiptsLogicSpec, BankStatementReviewRowSpec, BankStatementBulkRunsSpec, BankStatementReviewLogicSpec.
- Final acceptance check: `grep -rn "Hooks\.\(useEffect\|useMemo\|useCallback\)(" web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/components` should show only no-deps `Hooks.useEffect(fn)` calls, if any.

resultJson.title: Add SafeHooks and migrate component hook dependency lists to String keys
resultJson.body:
Adds `net.wiringbits.core.SafeHooks`, a wrapper over `Hooks.useEffect` / `useMemo` / `useCallback` that only accepts `String` dependency keys. Every component under `web/.../components` that passed a dependency list now uses it. React compares deps with `Object.is`, so in Scala.js only `String`/`Int`/`Double`/`Boolean` compare by value. Any other object passed as a dep is compared by reference, and a new instance on each render re-fires the hook.

- `SafeHooks`, plus `HookDepsProbeSpec` (shows which dep types are stable and that the empty-deps idioms are equivalent) and `SafeHooksSpec`.
- RULE-FE-006 in `docs/guide/frontend.md` and the frontend reviewer rule are rewritten to require `SafeHooks`.
- Call sites migrated as a behaviour-preserving refactor. Empty-deps idioms (`""`, `Seq.empty`, `js.Array()`, constant `js.Array("")`) become the no-arg compute-once form. Existing `String` keys are passed through unchanged. `BulkMerchantSetupPage`'s `Int` key becomes `page.toString`.

For reviewers: two files previously passed Scala objects as `useMemo` deps. `BankStatementReviewContent` passed state `List`s and an `Option`; `ReceiptsPage` passed `ruleList` and the merchants list. These now use content-derived keys (`toString` of the source case classes and lists; merchant `id:name` in `ReceiptsPage`). Derived memos compose their upstream keys. So the memos now recompute when the content changes, not when the reference changes. The memos are pure, so the results are the same.

No-deps `Hooks.useEffect(fn)` calls, `useState`/`useRef`, the `core` utilities (`ReactiveHooks`, `I18nHooks`) and `AsyncComponent(watchedObjects = ...)` are unchanged.
